title: GrimVeil
description: A dark expansion to your world adding a biome, 50+ blocks, a toolset, a material after netherite, and an eerie creature to fight and hide from.
body:
![GrimVeil Title Banner, featuring the a creature appearing behind the title.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3a0b22c2affd458112e8b124ca92383c76e74ac6_0.webp) GrimVeil is a dark exploration centered mod that introduces The Lost Woods. A strange, eerie place. seperated from the familiarity of the world you know.. Building around atmosphere, discovery, and going against the traditional experience. You are encouraged to explore and observe. To decide for yourself what is happening. and why... **If you like GrimVeil, check out the [Shade-Archive Discord Server](https://discord.gg/mwsxz39DjR) to hear about updates, report bugs, and talk with others who also enjoy the mod!** _-We're open to any suggestions you may have!_
License GrimVeil is licensed under LGPL-3.0-only. Here's a quick list of things you can do, and _can not_ do with the mod. ## Allowed & Encouraged: - Including GrimVeil in Mod-Packs _(Public or Private)_ - Creating Compatibility Mods, Integrations or Add-ons. - Sharing feedback, bug reports, and suggestions ## Strongly Discouraged, or Not Allowed: - Editing or Redistributing modified versions of GrimVeil - Forks intended to replace or compete with the project - Reuploads that alter behavior. ## Mod-Pack Creators: - GrimVeil itself, must remain unmodified - You do **not** need to open-source your Mod-pack A config will be implemented into GrimVeil following the Overhaul update, for leniency and easy editing of Configs, Balance, or Mobs. Please wait Patiently, or suggest idea's to add for the configs.
Contacts For Questions, permissions, or Feedback: **Discord:** @just_cerise
**Github:** _(Will be made soon for ease of access for bugs, issues, permissions, and more)_
## Official Download: This Modrinth page is the **only distribution source**. Other sites may reference the mod or have the file, but updates and files are maintained here. - **Do not** install the mod from anywhere but this Modrinth page, as safety is not guaranteed.
![A banner with the word Requirements, with a house structure in the background](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/afc7f9deee734b1c9c220bf9e4f7661b03fc67cf_0.webp) For GrimVeil to be installed, it requires these dependencies. - [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) - [Fabric API](https://www.modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) - [Terrablender 4.3.0.2](https://modrinth.com/mod/terrablender/version/BVtalJ0e) All dependencies are listed with the version download, and are all also available on Modrinth.
![A Banner of a camp inside the lost woods biome, featuring the text what's inside...](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a97524a7fb1684ca553661729ad8d56ca57ed9d_0.webp) - The Lost Woods biome/region - Unique hostile encounters within the forest - New blocks and progression at your disposal - Materials to utilize and progress further - Unique Structures hand-built for the region.
![A banner with the word Notice. with a background of the lost woods, a clearing revealing a structure](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9ea6444e2670674e928a06197221bb79aea8f90a_0.webp) Grimveil is an atmospheric driven experience. Features and Behaviors are subject to change in future releases. As an extra note. GrimVeil is actively being developed and refined. Future updates will focus on improving existing content, deepening the experience and atmosphere. Alongside adding new content, encounters, all while staying true to the mod's original direction.
![A banner with the words Modpack Usages. a background is of a player shaped creature, it's back turned from the camera](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/02f314b2bfd0ede2e332165ab09d0138d0d87ad1_0.webp) Mod-Packs are welcome. **Please contact me before including GrimVeil.** Please credit the mod and link back to the page. **Do Not:** - Reupload the mod - Modify it's contents - Redistribute it outside official sources.
![A banner with the notice of an OVERHAUL update to GrimVeil, it features the forest. with a player in the background](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fc5f3b479f7e2b889d13fb629c5bac00d79c3140_0.webp) A large Overhaul of GrimVeil is currently in development. This overhaul focuses on improving and refining existing ideas rather than changing the core direction of the mod. Please expect little updates until the overhaul is released. Here's a list of things to expect in preperation: - Older worlds may not remain compatible _(This will be taken into account, and avoided as much as possible)_ - Changes in mechanics and balance - Public details shared only when the update is ready.
